slot_operation.inventoryplus.sort.descri: Sorting may move items in and out of this slot.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.move_matchi: Move Matching may take items out of this slot.
Move Matching may put items into this slot.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.restock_tak: Restock may pull a refill out of this slot.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.restock_put: Restock may refill this slot when its item runs out or breaks.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.auto_tool_s: Auto Tool Switch may swap a tool into or out of this slot.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.column_cycl: Column Cycler may rotate items through this slot.
slot_operation.inventoryplus.hotbar_cycl: Hotbar Cycler may rotate items through this slot.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Can't be taken off once worn, except in Creative.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Less damage and knockback from explosions.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Mace hits partly ignore the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: In a thunderstorm, a thrown trident calls lightning down on what it hits.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Mace smash attacks hit harder for each block you fall.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Less fire damage, and you burn for less time.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set the target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water under your feet as you walk.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Extra trident damage to aquatic mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting doesn't use up normal arrows, as long as you carry one.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident flies back to you.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better odds of treasure when fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Experience you pick up repairs this item.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Fires three arrows for the cost of one.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Less damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Arrows knock the target back further.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: In water or rain, throwing the trident launches you with it.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Blocks drop themselves, like glass and ore.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil, wearing down the boots.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Hurts mobs that hit you, wearing down the armor.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Lasts longer: some damage to it is ignored.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A mace smash attack launches you back into the air.
